groups.heading: Program Leadership
groups.description: Oversight for the NJ Hitz program — culture, operations, and long-term development across all age groups.

coaches.name: Carlos Duran
coaches.bio: Duran brings over a decade of experience working with high-level travel and high-school programs across New Jersey. He focuses on developing softball IQ, leadership, and a healthy, competitive environment for every athlete in the program.
highlights: Guided multiple teams to regional and national-level events.
Leads program culture, communication, and long-term planning.
Supports player pathways for showcase and college recruiting.

coaches.name: John Babai
coaches.bio: Babai oversees day-to-day operations for NJ Hitz — team placement, scheduling, facilities, and communication — ensuring families have a clear, organized experience from season to season.
highlights: Coordinates multi-team schedules and tournament logistics.
Supports coaches with resources, equipment, and facilities.
Primary contact for families and prospective players.

groups.heading: 18U Coaching Staff
groups.description: Coaches working with our oldest age groups — focused on college-ready fundamentals, advanced game IQ, and the recruiting process.

coaches.name: Mike Caputo
coaches.bio: Caputo works closely with pitchers, catchers, and the infield to build strong defensive units. He emphasizes pitch-to-pitch focus, communication, and trusting the game plan.
highlights: Supports pitchers and catchers with game planning and pitch calling.
Teaches team defensive systems and communication.

coaches.name: Michael Borozan
coaches.bio: Borozan leads the 18U group with an emphasis on situational hitting, aggressive baserunning, and playing fast, intelligent softball. Practices are structured, high-tempo, and built around game-speed reps.
highlights: Experience coaching at high-level showcase and travel events.
Focus on offensive approach, pressure on the bases, and team defense.
Helps players prepare for the expectations of the next level.

coaches.name: Brittany Demarest
coaches.bio:
Brittany is a Mount Olive native and former standout at Saint Elizabeth University, where she competed in NCAA Division III softball from 2017–2022. A four-year team captain, CSAC All-Conference honoree, and five-time All-Academic selection, she holds a bachelor’s in Sports Management & Marketing and a master’s in Graphic Design & Media.

She currently serves as Assistant Coach for the NJ Hitz 18U Showcase Team and coaches at County College of Morris (JUCO). Her background in collegiate athletics, coaching, and sports communications gives her strong insight into player development, recruiting, and athlete mentorship.
highlights: Former NCAA DIII athlete & four-year team captain
CSAC All-Conference; 5× All-Academic Team
18U Showcase Assistant Coach
JUCO coach – County College of Morris

coaches.name: Amanda DiZinno
coaches.bio:
Amanda is a 2009 graduate of Mount Olive High School, where she played varsity softball from 2006–2009, winning both a conference championship and a state sectional title. She earned multiple All-Conference and All-County honors and joined the 100 Hits Club with 129 career hits.

She went on to play at Moravian University from 2010–2013, appearing in 162 career games. Moravian captured three conference championships, a regional championship, and made a 2010 Division III College World Series appearance, with that team later inducted into the Moravian Hall of Fame. Amanda recorded 141 career hits and held single-season and career put-out records for both Moravian and the Landmark Conference. She has coached with the NJ Hitz 18U program since 2020.
highlights: Mount Olive varsity standout & 100 Hits Club (129 hits)
Conference & state sectional champion at Mount Olive HS
Moravian University DIII athlete (162 career games)
2010 DIII College World Series appearance & Hall of Fame team member
18U NJ Hitz coach since 2020

groups.description: Coaches building the foundation — core mechanics, confidence, and softball IQ for players preparing to move into upper-level competition.

coaches.name: Dean Taylor
coaches.bio:
Dean brings coaching, team management, and program operations experience to the NJ Hitz program. In addition to player development, Dean leads organizational technology and branding efforts — helping unify communication, digital presence, and behind-the-scenes operations. He also serves as a liaison with the Mount Olive Baseball & Softball Association to support coordinated programming and community alignment.

On the field, Dean emphasizes effort, communication, and strong fundamentals, helping 12U athletes adjust to faster play and more advanced team concepts. His approach focuses on building confidence, leadership, and a supportive team-first culture.
highlights: Leads NJ Hitz technology, branding, and digital operations
Liaison with Mt. Olive Baseball & Softball Association
Emphasizes effort, communication, and fundamentals
Builds confidence & leadership in developing athletes
